rule: Rule, inputs, thresholds and staking written to the repo before any graded result.
evidence: Every strategy on the strategy page is written before its numbers are computed; the builder runs once.

rule: At least 200 graded decisions before any skill claim.
evidence: Measured n is printed for every strategy; none reaches the threshold.

rule: Fit on earlier weeks, grade on later weeks. Never fit and grade the same game.
evidence: The open snapshot fits through week W-2 and the close snapshot through week W-1; grading uses week W only.

rule: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.10 across every strategy tested in a family.
evidence: Applied to the family of strategies once any member reaches the sample-size gate.

rule: Must beat a named benchmark, not a guess. Here: the no-knowledge constant baseline.
evidence: Every signal is a contest against a baseline fitted on the same training weeks.

rule: 95% interval on the signal metric must exclude the no-skill value before promotion.
evidence: Wilson intervals and exact binomial p-values are printed; none excludes no-skill yet.

rule: Deflated Sharpe: the reward is discounted by the number of strategies tried.
evidence: Deflated Sharpe is reported with the trial count; unevaluable until a payoff series exists (F-01).

rule: Parlay legs must show a measured joint distribution, not a product of marginals.
evidence: Measured for the same-game and cross-game doubles on the correlation page, with n.

rule: Every input row carries an official source URL and a retrieval date.
evidence: Enforced by scripts/verify_signals.py: every row links an official source or carries a flag.

rule: Inputs must be published before the decision cutoff for that game.
evidence: Ratings use only finals from earlier weeks; the injury report is only used for the week it covers.

rule: Every originated market has both an opening and a closing number in the store.
evidence: Enforced by scripts/verify_signals.py against the price-snapshot store.

rule: A leaderboard rank can never be earned by staking alone.
evidence: Enforced by scripts/verify_signals.py: the leaderboard ranks on signal columns only.
